title: Recording, mixing: Medicine Jar by Wings | 1975
content:
Studio 3, Wally Heider Recording, Los Angeles
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan O’Duffy

A mixing session for Wings’ fourth album Venus And Mars took place on 22 March 1975.

The album’s ninth song, ‘Medicine Jar’, was mixed into stereo on this day. However, Paul McCartney decided that the song required more harmony vocals, so an overdub was taped before the final mix was created. It was the final recording for the album.
